lead: Cinematic sci-fi war film still in orbit, olive drab mecha, amber beam light.
notes: Mood-only mini images for Halberd_Suit_Wars.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen Halberd_Suit_Wars-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish Halberd_Suit_Wars-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: colonies
images.prompt: Giant rotating colony cylinders floating in space above a blue planet, a moon behind them.

images.name: suit
images.prompt: A humanoid war machine as tall as a building standing in a hangar, holding a huge rifle.

images.name: arena
images.prompt: Armored humanoid robots drifting among asteroids and wrecked ships, firing glowing beams.

images.name: operation
images.prompt: A tactical map table glowing with battle positions in a dim military command room.

images.name: war
images.prompt: A grey moon with a fortified base, warships in orbit and flashes of battle in the distance.

images.name: briefing
images.prompt: Pilots in flight suits resting in a ready room between sorties, helmets on the bench.

images.name: limb
images.prompt: A robot arm bursting into a fireball in space, oil and sparks spraying from the joint.

images.name: pilot
images.prompt: A tiny astronaut with a jetpack and a bazooka floating near a wrecked giant robot.

images.name: squad
images.prompt: Three armored humanoid robots in formation boosting through space, thruster trails behind.

images.name: retreat
images.prompt: A damaged humanoid robot with one arm gone flying away from a battle toward a carrier ship.
